        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5487"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3746">theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan</rs> gyi rnam par bshad pa theg chen rab gsal snang ba</rs> zhes pa | sdom rtson sde snod 'dzin pa mang pos snga mo nas bskul zhing | khyad par du'ang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5965">dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po khams pa lo tsa ba ma Ni kashri jnya</rs> nas yang yang du bskul ba'i ngor | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4128">bod kyi paNDi ta ma ti rha ja shri bha dra</rs>s | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5736">dge ldan sa bzangs</rs> su sbyar ba'o || bstan pa rin chen dang sems can mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig || maM galaM bha wa tu | </seg></TEI>
